home.definingStatement: A globally leading independent art consultancy helping private clients, trusts, museums and corporations buy, sell and manage their collections.

opening.p1: Rufus Bird Art Advisory was established to guide collectors through the art world: navigating markets, sourcing exceptional works, refining collections, advising on conservation, and managing legacies with complete transparency, clarity and trust.
opening.p2: We understand that collecting art is so much more than the acquisition of objects. It is the deliberate culmination of emotion, legacy, reputation and passion. Which is why having a reputable, informed, and independent partner at your side makes a profound difference.
opening.p3: With twenty-five years inside the art world, Rufus Bird is one of the most trusted and sought-after independent voices in it. A Cambridge graduate, he trained at Christie's in European Furniture & Works of Art, spent over ten years at the highest level inside the Royal Household managing the decorative arts of the Royal Collection for the British Royal Family, and led the European Furniture & Works of Art department at Gurr Johns before founding this practice in 2019. He is a published author and a connoisseur with a wealth of stories, objects, and contacts across the globe — now offering discreet, unconflicted counsel to private clients and institutions.
opening.p4: You may be a seasoned collector pursuing a specific piece, a family office stewarding significant assets, an interior designer seeking a focal centrepiece, or a trustee of an estate needing a valuation or direction. Whatever your starting point, Rufus Bird Art Advisory offers tailored, bespoke guidance as a trusted partner throughout your journey with art.

bio.p1: I studied History of Art at Cambridge and trained as a specialist at Christie's, in the European Furniture & Works of Art department. I spent a formative decade inside the Royal Household as Surveyor of The Queen's Works of Art, with responsibility for the decorative arts of the Royal Collection — the kind of post that teaches you, permanently, to put the object before the label. I went on to lead European Furniture & Works of Art at Gurr Johns, before opening this practice in Shaftesbury in 2019.
bio.p2: The practice is deliberately small: one principal, a network of specialists I have worked with for years, and a working library that has grown with the work. I accept mandates selectively, with a strong preference for long relationships over single transactions. I correspond in English, German, and French; in Spanish and Italian where the occasion requires it.
bio.p3: People tell me the same thing, usually after we have worked together for a while: that the work feels more like counsel than brokerage. That it is, in some ways, quieter than they expected. I take that as the highest compliment.
